tei:div.tei:p: ༈ snying gtam sum cu pa zhes bya ba bzhugs/

chos dbyings mkha' khyab ye shes smon lam sprin chen las/ /thugs rje'i tsha zer bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun legs phab nas/ /gdul bya'i zhing du sku gsum myu gu smin mdzad pa'i/ /skyabs gsum mchog gyur skyob mdzad bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /smon lam stobs kyis sgrub brgyud dam pas rjes bzung yang*/ /rang nyid mi brtson don med dus 'das tshe 'di grib sor gtugs/ / drang srong spyod bsam rang la yi mug de 'dra gzhan yang mthong*/ /de phyir rang blo nges 'byung bskul phyir snying gtam sum cu brjod/ /kye ho sna tshogs thabs kyis 'khor mang bsdus nas ni/ /mthun rkyen 'dzom sa pa'i dgon gzhis 'dzin pa yang*/ /rtsod pa'i gzhi dang bdag sems zhen pa'i rgyu/ /gcig pur sdod pa kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /grong chog sri'u gso 'dre 'dul la sogs kyi/ /yon tan skye bo'i dbus su brin gyur kyang*/ /zas nor sred pas bdag blo bdud kyis khyer/ /rang sems 'dul ba kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /dbul phongs rnams la khral chen bsdus nas ni/ /rten chen bzhengs dang yo langs 'gyed la sogs/ /dge la brten nas gzhan sdig gsog pa'i rgyu/ /rang sems dge ba kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /rang che 'dod phyir gzhan la chos bshad dang*/ /thabs mkhas chen pos mchog dman 'khor skyong ba/ /dngos 'dzin sems kyi nga rgyal skye ba'i rgyu/ /blo sna bstung ba kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /tshong dang bun skyed g.yo sgyu la sogs kyi/ / log 'tshos bsags pa'i nor rdzas brgya 'bul yang*/ /lo 'dod dge ba chos brgyad dag gi rgyu/ /zhen log sgom pa kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /gnya' dang dbang po zhal lce la sogs kyis/ /gzhan rtsod bsdum pa 'gro don yin snyam yang*/ /de la bsten pa'i zhe 'dod 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /re dogs med pa kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ / mnga' ris longs spyod 'khor dang bsod nams dang*/

/snyan pa'i gtam gyis 'dzam gling gang gyur kyang*/ /rang nyid 'chi tshe phan pa gcig kyang med/ /sgrub la brtson pa kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /gnyer pa nye gnas gtso bo la sogs pa/ /thabs kha gra sa'i srog shing yin mod kyang*/ /gzung 'dzin blo yi sems khral 'byung ba'i rgyu/ /'du 'dzi bskyung ba kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ / rten mchod dpe cha thabs kha la sogs pa/ /ci dgos khur nas ri khrod 'grims pa yang*/ /'phral la 'dzom ste sdug bsngal rtsod pa'i rgyu/ /dgos med bsten pa kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /snyigs ma'i dus 'dir dmu rgod 'khor rnams la/ / bka' bkyon la sogs phan sems yin mod kyang*/ /de la brten nas nyon mongs skye ba'i rgyu/ /zhi bar smra ba kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /phan pa'i sems kyis rang 'dod med pa'i gtam/ /brtse bas mi la mtshang nas brjod pa yang*/ / drang po yin kyang snying skran 'jug pa'i rgyu/ /snyan par smra ba kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /rang phyogs skyong zhing gzhan phyogs dgag pa'i rgyu/ /bgro gleng bstan pa'i gad bdar yin snyam yang*/ /de la brten nas nyon mongs skye ba'i rgyu/ /smra bcad byed pa kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /bla ma bka' rgyud grub mtha' la sogs pa/ / phyogs ris kha 'dzin zhabs tog yin snyam yang*/ /rang bstod gzhan smad chags sdang dag gi rgyu/ /thams cad bskyur ba kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /thos pas chos kyi rnam dbye la dpyad nas/ /gzhan skyon rtogs pa shes rab yin snyam yang*/ /de la brten nas rang sdig gsog pa'i rgyu/ / dag snang sbyong ba kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /stong skad had pos rgyu 'bras khyad bsad de/ /byar med chos kyi mthar thug yin snyam yang*/ /tshogs gnyis spangs pas nyams len skal ba chad/ /zung 'jug sgom pa kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /gsum pa'i don du thig le dbab pa sogs/ /gzhan lus lam gyi bogs 'don yin snyam yang*/ /zag bcas lam gyis sgom chen bslus pa mang*/

/grol lam spyod pa kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ / skal med dag la dbang bskur sbyin pa dang*/ /skye bo'i dbus su dam rdzas 'grem la sogs/ /gshe skur gzhi dang dam tshig nyams pa'i rgyu/ /btsun 'go 'don pa kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /skye bo'i dbus su gcer rgyug byed la sogs/ /tho co'i spyod pa brtul zhugs yin snyam yang*/ /'jig rten pa dag ma dad skye ba'i rgyu/ / bag yod bsten pa kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /sa phyogs 'di na bdag nyid mchog 'dod phyir/ /btsun dang mkhas shing bzang por sgrub pa yang*/ /mthon po'i rtse nas dma' sar lhung ba'i rgyu/ /thang lhod med pa kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /grong dang dgon pa ri khrod la sogs pa/ /gang du sdod kyang sgos mdza' mi 'tshol zhing*/ /su dang 'grogs kyang mi mdza' mi 'khon par/ /rang tshugs 'dzin pa kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /dad ldan pho mos 'tsho ba sbyar byas nas/ /bzang por bkur nas tshul 'chos spyod pa yang*/ /gzhan sems bsrung phyir bdag nyid 'ching ba'i rgyu/ /ro snyoms spyod pa kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /bzo rtsis sman sogs yig sna dpag med pa'i/ /rten 'brel thabs kun rnam mkhyen rgyu yin kyang*/ /sna tshogs mang pos bsam gtan gcog pa'i rgyu/ /shes bya bskyung ba kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /nang du sdod tshe khang pa'i bkod sogs dang*/ /dben pa'i khong nas phun tshogs sgrub pa yang*/ /don chung ngang la mi tshe 'dzad pa'i rgyu/ /bya byed bshol ba kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /mkhas dang btsun sogs sgrub la brtson gyur cing*/ /phyogs re'i yon tan phul du phyin na yang*/ /gang zhen de yis bdag rgyud 'ching ba'i rgyu/ / phyogs med khrol shes kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ / thog ser la sogs gtad srung sna tshogs kyis/ /gdul dka' 'dul ba phrin las yin snyan yang*/ /gzhan rgyud bsregs shing rang nyid ngan 'gro'i rgyu/ / dman sa 'dzin pa kho bo'i snying gtam yin/

/gzhung dang zhal gdams zin bris la sogs pa/ / zab mo'i dpe cha dgos rgu 'dzoms na yang*/ /nyams len ma byas 'chi tshe dpes mi phan/ /sems la lta ba kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /rtse gcig sgrub tshe nyams dang go bsdur dang*/ /bstan bcos rtsom dang nyams dbyangs len la sogs/ /rtsal snang yin yang rnam rtog 'phel ba'i rgyu/ /blo bral skyong ba kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /rnam rtog skyes tshe gcer gyis lta ba gces/ / sems thag chod tshe thog tu bzhag pa gces/ /sgom du med pa sgom du bzhag pa gces/ /yengs med skyong ba kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /stong nyid ngang nas rgyu 'bras spyod byed cing*/ /byar med rtogs nas sdom gsum bsrung ba dang*/ / dmigs med snying rjes 'gro la phan brtson pa/ /tshogs gnyis dbyer med kho bo'i snying gtam yin/ /mkhas grub bla ma mang bsten gdams pa zab mo'ang thos/ /mdo rgyud zab mo 'ga' mthong cung zhig nang du'ang brtags/ /shes bzhin mi spyod kyi hud rang gis rang bslus pa/ /bdag dang bdag 'dra'i tshul la snying gtam sum cu bshad/ /nges 'byung yid kyis 'di brtsams dge des 'gro ba kun/ /srid pa'i dgon pa las bsgral bde chen la bkod de/ /dus gsum rgyal dang de sras drang srong che rnams kyi/ /rjes su spyod pa'i sras kyi thu bor bdag gyur cig /snying gtam sum cu pa zhes bya ba nges par 'byung ba cung zad kyi blos bskul ba tshul khrims blo gros kyis sbyar ba'o// //dge'o// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (24) snying gtam sum cu pa/ -PAGE 392--PAGE 389--PAGE 388-
